historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission unanimously disapproved a 61-unit apartment complex in two buildings on the site, facing Stockton Street and Midway Street, as too large for the family neighbourhood behind it (Resolution 7620).

The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Public Works' denial of a permit to erect a structure at 2120 Stockton Street, the appeal being denied for lack of the required four overrule votes.
By 17 February 1977, the Board of Permit Appeals had left standing, on a 2–2 vote, the City Planning Commission's refusal of a building permit for an apartment building on the lot.
